fct_orders.description: One row per order. Reconciles the order total against its lines and against the captured payment. reconciliation_status is matched, amount_mismatch or unpaid.

fct_order_items.description: One row per order line, with the product category and the difference against list price.

dim_customers.description: One row per identified customer, with first touch and lifetime value.

fct_daily_funnel.description: Sessions per day and client, and how many reached each funnel step. Incremental: each run rebuilds the last funnel_lookback_days days.
